登录时除了密码，还要输入手机验证器 App 上的动态验证码: Signing in also asks for a code from an authenticator app on the user's phone
关闭后登录不再询问验证码，用户已有的绑定会保留: When off, sign-in stops asking for codes; existing setups are kept
这些角色的成员登录时如果还没绑定，会先要求绑定，且不能自行关闭: Members of these roles must set it up at sign-in and can't turn it off
设置或修改密码时校验，已有密码不受影响: Checked whenever a password is set; existing passwords are not affected
限流按 IP 统计；多实例部署时每个实例分别计数: Limits are per IP; with several instances each one counts separately
AI 对话、AI 数据查询等功能使用的 OpenAI 兼容接口: The OpenAI-compatible API used by AI chat, AI data query and other AI features
一段时间不操作后需要重新登录（有操作时自动续期）: Users sign in again after this long without activity (activity extends it)
使用表单里当前的值测试（包括还没保存的修改），不会保存: Tests the values currently in the form, including unsaved changes; nothing is saved
加密保存，保存后不再显示: Stored encrypted and never shown again after saving
发一条很短的消息，确认地址、API Key 和模型名可用: Sends a very short message to check the URL, API key and model name
只影响之后上传的文件；已有文件仍从原来的位置读取: Applies to new uploads; existing files are still read from where they were stored
同一 IP 或同一账号连续失败达到次数后暂时锁定: Locks the IP or account for a while after this many failed attempts
同时受服务器请求体上限 MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH 限制: Also capped by the server's request size limit (MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH)
已有 {{count}} 个文件存放在 S3 上。如果新的接口地址或密钥访问不到: {{count}} files are stored on S3. If the new endpoint or keys can't reach the original bucket, they can no longer be read; changing only the bucket doesn't affect existing files.
已设置，留空则不修改: Set — leave empty to keep it
扩展名，回车添加；上传时还会检查文件内容与扩展名是否一致: Extensions; press Enter to add. Uploads are also checked for content matching the extension
桶可公开读取时填写，下载直接跳到这里；留空则使用 10 分钟有效的签名地址: Set it when the bucket is publicly readable and downloads redirect there; otherwise signed URLs valid for 10 minutes are used
用于发送找回密码等邮件: Used to send password reset and other mails
用户访问后台的地址，找回密码邮件里的链接用它拼接: The address users open the admin at; links in password reset mails are built from it
由环境变量 {{name}} 指定，不能在这里修改: Set by the environment variable {{name}}; can't be changed here
留空为 us-east-1；Cloudflare R2 填 auto: Empty means us-east-1; use auto for Cloudflare R2
登录、两步验证、找回密码共用: Shared by sign-in, two-step verification and password reset
登录页显示「忘记密码」；链接 30 分钟内有效、只能使用一次: Shows "Forgot password" on the sign-in page; links are valid for 30 minutes and work once
选择「S3 兼容存储」时使用: Used when S3-compatible storage is selected
需要先在「邮件」里配置好 SMTP 和网站地址: Needs SMTP and the site URL under Mail
需要先在「邮件」中配置 SMTP 服务器: Set up an SMTP server under Mail first
需要先在「邮件」中填写网站地址（重置链接要用）: Enter the site URL under Mail first (reset links use it)
演示环境不能开启此功能: This can't be turned on in the demo
S3 兼容存储包括 AWS S3、MinIO、阿里云 OSS、腾讯云 COS、C: S3-compatible storage covers AWS S3, MinIO, Alibaba Cloud OSS, Tencent COS and Cloudflare R2
自动：465 端口用 SSL/TLS，其他端口用 STARTTLS: Auto: SSL/TLS on port 465, STARTTLS on other ports
自动：填了接口地址时用路径风格（MinIO 等自建服务需要）: Auto: path style when an endpoint is set (needed by MinIO and other self-hosted services)
开启后用户可以在个人设置里创建 API Token；关闭后已有的 Token 全: Users can create API tokens in Profile. Turning this off pauses every existing token until it’s turned back on
脚本和其他系统用 API Token 调用接口；Webhook 不受这个开关影响: Scripts and other systems call the API with API tokens; webhooks aren’t affected by this switch
